description: Score people in one owned sheet against the workspace ICP or an explicitly linked campaign audience, using the data and signals Nock already has. Returns fit, priority, coverage, status, evidence gaps and concise explanations per row. Use the active selected rowIds when present; omit rowIds only when the user means the whole sheet. This does not search LinkedIn, Reddit or the open web. Works on any sheet: only its people are scored; companies without a person are skipped.

campaignId.description: Campaign UUID only when the sheet is being qualified for that campaign.

rowIds.description: Optional exact row ids. Omit to qualify every row in the sheet.
